data.body: Detached from epic compliant-lemon-grunion (759e-7dc1-675c-4877) at epic close. This ticket is explicitly parked in 'idea' status as future/optional enrichment work (its own description states it awaits a promotion decision: human-adjudication budget, a promotion-decision record, or staffing). It is not part of the epic's committed scope (the Tier-2 harness fix + ADR 0109 docs, per the epic's actual delivery brief), and rebar's structural open-children guard blocks closing a parent with any non-closed child, idea status included. Detaching (not closing/rejecting) preserves the idea verbatim, fully promotable later via 'rebar edit --parent <new-epic-or-none>' + 'transition idea open', with its discovered_from/relates_to/depends_on links intact. No content lost.
